_comment: Machine-readable mirror of the provenance table in scripts/upstream/README.md §快照清单.
The Markdown table remains the human source of truth — this file exists only so a
zero-dependency script can read it. scripts/verify-upstream-snapshot.mjs cross-checks
every entry below against that table and fails with exit code 2 if the two disagree,
so neither can be edited without the other.
OUTSTANDING DEBT: until README.md §快照清单 is reworded to point here, this fact has two
homes. The cross-check makes divergence fail loudly; it does not make it impossible.

declared_unenforced.reason: 本目录的说明与来源表本身。「如何更新」第 6 步明确要求更新它，所以它按流程必须可改，因此不做逐字节钉死；它的作用由 verify 脚本的 prose 交叉校验守住。
本仓库自有的派生映射与逐版本裁决日志（契约 3.4 补充），允许本地改写并登记漂移，见其 §3/§6/§7。不是上游字节，故无上游 sha256。
README §用途 记为「历史参考」：我方 classifyTask 源自此文件的扩展版正则，**已本地 diverge**。它是上游派生起点而非逐字节快照，故本仓库从未记录其上游 sha256，钉死本地值只会把一次有意为之的本地改写伪装成上游事实。
